{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Duffle Bag''' was a tanky enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had way higher health than every enemy that spawned before it, but at the cost of also being slower than them. It also had 25% [[Defense]]. ==Appearance== The '''Duffle Bag''' is a black duffle bag with the Adidas logo on it. It has block arms and legs which wear a black shirt, pants and shoes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **Towers like the [[Trapper]] can also bypass its [[Defense]]. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} DuffleBagCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DuffleBagIconIG.png|'''Duffle Bag''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Duffle Bag''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Duffle Bag''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Duffle Bag's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. **{{Bug}} '''Duffle Bag''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Duffle Bag''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BackyardBeginnings|[[Sports Drink]]|Wave 7|Duffle Bag|Wave 8|[[Referee]]|Wave 10}} {{CompetitionCourt|[[Sports Drink]]|Wave 8|Duffle Bag|Wave 9|[[Referee]]|Wave 10 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Referee]] & [[Soccer Speedy]]|hardw3 = Wave 10 (Hard)}} {{VictoryField|[[Sports Drink]]|Wave 8|Duffle Bag|Wave 9|[[Referee]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
